section_anchor: Compatibility: the part the colourway does not tell you
brief_summary: Two-column do/don't fit map. The Wooting 60HE column (KS-20 family) lists KS-20 White, KS-20 Orange, Magnetic Jade (coral-emphasised), and Magnetic Jade Pro with coral ticks. The Keychron Q1 HE column (KS-37 family) lists Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic (stock) and Jade Mini E. Two warm-red crossed dashed lines between the columns mark 'Magnetic Jade: not supported — per Keychron's Q1 HE listing' and 'KS-37 series: not compatible with Wooting's PCB'.
data_sources: apps/web/src/content/articles/gateron-magnetic-jade-deep-dive.mdx:'Compatibility' — 'hlplanet's 60HE compatibility guide lists the KS-20 White, the KS-20T Magnetic Jade, and the Jade Pro as tested fits while noting the KS-37 series is not compatible with Wooting's PCB' (cited to https://www.hlplanet.com/wooting-compability-guide/)

https://www.hlplanet.com/gateron-magnetic-switches/ — 'Wooting 60HE+/80HE supports Gateron KS-20 models' (White and Orange); 'KS-37 model uses different weighted magnets which are not compatible with Wooting'
